en.text: The book of the genealogy of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.

footnotes.text: 1:1 Messiah (Hebrew) and Christ (Greek) both mean “Anointed One”

zhSimplified.text: 亚伯拉罕的后裔，大卫的子孙，耶稣基督的家谱：

footnotes.text: - 1:1 后裔，子孙：原文是儿子；下同

zhTraditional.text: 亞伯拉罕的後裔，大衛的子孫，耶穌基督的家譜：

footnotes.text: - 1:1 後裔，子孫：原文是兒子；下同

en.text: Abraham became the father of Isaac. Isaac became the father of Jacob. Jacob became the father of Judah and his brothers.

zhSimplified.text: 亚伯拉罕生以撒；以撒生雅各；雅各生犹大和他的弟兄；

zhTraditional.text: 亞伯拉罕生以撒；以撒生雅各；雅各生猶大和他的弟兄；

en.text: Judah became the father of Perez and Zerah by Tamar. Perez became the father of Hezron. Hezron became the father of Ram.

zhSimplified.text: 犹大从她玛氏生法勒斯和谢拉；法勒斯生希斯 ；希斯 生亚兰；

zhTraditional.text: 猶大從她瑪氏生法勒斯和謝拉；法勒斯生希斯崙；希斯崙生亞蘭；

en.text: Ram became the father of Amminadab. Amminadab became the father of Nahshon. Nahshon became the father of Salmon.

zhSimplified.text: 亚兰生亚米拿达；亚米拿达生拿顺；拿顺生撒门；

zhTraditional.text: 亞蘭生亞米拿達；亞米拿達生拿順；拿順生撒門；

en.text: Salmon became the father of Boaz by Rahab. Boaz became the father of Obed by Ruth. Obed became the father of Jesse.

zhSimplified.text: 撒门从喇合氏生波阿斯；波阿斯从路得氏生俄备得；俄备得生耶西；

zhTraditional.text: 撒門從喇合氏生波阿斯；波阿斯從路得氏生俄備得；俄備得生耶西；

en.text: Jesse became the father of King David. David the king became the father of Solomon by her who had been Uriah’s wife.

zhSimplified.text: 耶西生大卫王。 大卫从乌利亚的妻子生所罗门；

zhTraditional.text: 耶西生大衛王。 大衛從烏利亞的妻子生所羅門；

en.text: Solomon became the father of Rehoboam. Rehoboam became the father of Abijah. Abijah became the father of Asa.

zhSimplified.text: 所罗门生罗波安；罗波安生亚比雅；亚比雅生亚撒；

zhTraditional.text: 所羅門生羅波安；羅波安生亞比雅；亞比雅生亞撒；

en.text: Asa became the father of Jehoshaphat. Jehoshaphat became the father of Joram. Joram became the father of Uzziah.

zhSimplified.text: 亚撒生约沙法；约沙法生约兰； 约兰生乌西雅；

zhTraditional.text: 亞撒生約沙法；約沙法生約蘭；約蘭生烏西雅；

en.text: Uzziah became the father of Jotham. Jotham became the father of Ahaz. Ahaz became the father of Hezekiah.

zhSimplified.text: 乌西雅生约坦；约坦生亚哈斯；亚哈斯生希西家；

zhTraditional.text: 烏西雅生約坦；約坦生亞哈斯；亞哈斯生希西家；

en.text: Hezekiah became the father of Manasseh. Manasseh became the father of Amon. Amon became the father of Josiah.

zhSimplified.text: 希西家生玛拿西；玛拿西生亚们；亚们生约西亚；

zhTraditional.text: 希西家生瑪拿西；瑪拿西生亞們；亞們生約西亞；

en.text: Josiah became the father of Jechoniah and his brothers at the time of the exile to Babylon.

zhSimplified.text: 百姓被迁到巴比伦的时候，约西亚生耶哥尼雅和他的弟兄。

zhTraditional.text: 百姓被遷到巴比倫的時候，約西亞生耶哥尼雅和他的弟兄。

en.text: After the exile to Babylon, Jechoniah became the father of Shealtiel. Shealtiel became the father of Zerubbabel.

zhSimplified.text: 迁到巴比伦之后，耶哥尼雅生撒拉铁；撒拉铁生所罗巴伯；

zhTraditional.text: 遷到巴比倫之後，耶哥尼雅生撒拉鐵；撒拉鐵生所羅巴伯；

en.text: Zerubbabel became the father of Abiud. Abiud became the father of Eliakim. Eliakim became the father of Azor.

zhSimplified.text: 所罗巴伯生亚比玉；亚比玉生以利亚敬；以利亚敬生亚所；

zhTraditional.text: 所羅巴伯生亞比玉；亞比玉生以利亞敬；以利亞敬生亞所；

en.text: Azor became the father of Zadok. Zadok became the father of Achim. Achim became the father of Eliud.

zhSimplified.text: 亚所生撒督；撒督生亚金；亚金生以律；

zhTraditional.text: 亞所生撒督；撒督生亞金；亞金生以律；

en.text: Eliud became the father of Eleazar. Eleazar became the father of Matthan. Matthan became the father of Jacob.

zhSimplified.text: 以律生以利亚撒；以利亚撒生马但；马但生雅各；

zhTraditional.text: 以律生以利亞撒；以利亞撒生馬但；馬但生雅各；

en.text: Jacob became the father of Joseph, the husband of Mary, from whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.

zhSimplified.text: 雅各生约瑟，就是马利亚的丈夫。那称为基督的耶稣是从马利亚生的。

zhTraditional.text: 雅各生約瑟，就是馬利亞的丈夫。那稱為基督的耶穌是從馬利亞生的。

en.text: So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; from David to the exile to Babylon fourteen generations; and from the carrying away to Babylon to the Christ, fourteen generations.

zhSimplified.text: 这样，从亚伯拉罕到大卫共有十四代；从大卫到迁至巴比伦的时候也有十四代；从迁至巴比伦的时候到基督又有十四代。 （路2·1—7）

zhTraditional.text: 這樣，從亞伯拉罕到大衛共有十四代；從大衛到遷至巴比倫的時候也有十四代；從遷至巴比倫的時候到基督又有十四代。 （路2‧1－7）

en.text: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was like this: After his mother, Mary, was engaged to Joseph, before they came together, she was found pregnant by the Holy Spirit.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣基督降生的事记在下面：他母亲马利亚已经许配了约瑟，还没有迎娶，马利亚就从圣灵怀了孕。

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌基督降生的事記在下面：他母親馬利亞已經許配了約瑟，還沒有迎娶，馬利亞就從聖靈懷了孕。

en.text: Joseph, her husband, being a righteous man, and not willing to make her a public example, intended to put her away secretly.

zhSimplified.text: 她丈夫约瑟是个义人，不愿意明明地羞辱她，想要暗暗地把她休了。

zhTraditional.text: 她丈夫約瑟是個義人，不願意明明地羞辱她，想要暗暗地把她休了。

en.text: But when he thought about these things, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream, saying, “Joseph, son of David, don’t be afraid to take to yourself Mary as your wife, for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Spirit.

footnotes.text: 1:20 “Behold”, from “ἰδοὺ”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection.

zhSimplified.text: 正思念这事的时候，有主的使者向他梦中显现，说：「大卫的子孙约瑟，不要怕！只管娶过你的妻子马利亚来，因她所怀的孕是从圣灵来的。

zhTraditional.text: 正思念這事的時候，有主的使者向他夢中顯現，說：「大衛的子孫約瑟，不要怕！只管娶過你的妻子馬利亞來，因她所懷的孕是從聖靈來的。

en.text: She shall give birth to a son. You shall name him Jesus, for it is he who shall save his people from their sins.”

zhSimplified.text: 她将要生一个儿子，你要给他起名叫耶稣，因他要将自己的百姓从罪恶里救出来。」

zhTraditional.text: 她將要生一個兒子，你要給他起名叫耶穌，因他要將自己的百姓從罪惡裏救出來。」

en.text: Now all this has happened that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying,

zhSimplified.text: 这一切的事成就是要应验主借先知所说的话，

zhTraditional.text: 這一切的事成就是要應驗主藉先知所說的話，

en.text: “Behold, the virgin shall be with child, and shall give birth to a son. They shall call his name Immanuel,” which is, being interpreted, “God with us.”

zhSimplified.text: 说： 必有童女怀孕生子； 人要称他的名为以马内利。 以马内利翻出来就是「 神与我们同在」。）

zhTraditional.text: 說： 必有童女懷孕生子； 人要稱他的名為以馬內利。 以馬內利翻出來就是「上帝與我們同在」。）

en.text: Joseph arose from his sleep, and did as the angel of the Lord commanded him, and took his wife to himself;

zhSimplified.text: 约瑟醒了，起来，就遵着主使者的吩咐把妻子娶过来；

zhTraditional.text: 約瑟醒了，起來，就遵着主使者的吩咐把妻子娶過來；

en.text: and didn’t know her sexually until she had given birth to her firstborn son. He named him Jesus.

zhSimplified.text: 只是没有和她同房，等她生了儿子，就给他起名叫耶稣。

footnotes.text: - 1:25 有古卷：等她生了头胎的儿子

zhTraditional.text: 只是沒有和她同房，等她生了兒子，就給他起名叫耶穌。

footnotes.text: - 1:25 有古卷：等她生了頭胎的兒子
